title: There Was No Lakshmana Rekha

captions.instagram:
Was the Lakshmana Rekha ever really drawn?

Everyone 'knows' Lakshmana drew a line Sita must not cross. In Valmiki's Ramayana there is no line and no spell — Lakshmana leaves with a prayer to the forest deities. The Rekha came from later retellings.

📜 Source: Valmiki Ramayana, Aranya Kanda 3(42-47)

captions.youtube_description:
Was the Lakshmana Rekha ever really drawn?

Everyone 'knows' Lakshmana drew a line Sita must not cross. In Valmiki's Ramayana there is no line and no spell — Lakshmana leaves with a prayer to the forest deities. The Rekha came from later retellings.

Source: Valmiki Ramayana, Aranya Kanda 3(42-47)
Verses:
• No line (rekha) is drawn by Lakshmana — 3.43 (CE): Lakshmana leaves after a blessing; no line, no mantra
• Maricha cries 'Ha Sita! Ha Lakshmana!' in Rama's voice — 3.42
• Sita accuses Lakshmana of coming for her / being sent by Bharata — 3.43.21-22
• Blessing: may the forest deities protect you; may I see you again with Rama — 3.43.30-31
• Ravana arrives as a mendicant; trees and Godavari still in fear — 3.44
• Sita offers him water/hospitality — 3.44
• Lakshmana Rekha appears in later retellings, not Valmiki — absent from Valmiki CE 3.42-47
